False positive: POST /auth/password compares current_password with the stored Argon2id hash in Go and never sends it to SQL; its per-username rate limit (401, then 429) makes the boolean SQL-injection check see differing answers. Owner decision 2026-11-06.

The backup image runs as root by design: backup and restore write to a BACKUP_TARGET host folder of any owner, and restore chowns the media to 65532. In deploy/compose.yaml it has cap_drop ALL plus only DAC_OVERRIDE (restore adds CHOWN and FOWNER), no-new-privileges and no ports. DS-0002 still blocks on every other Dockerfile. Owner decision 2026-11-06.

Go standard library CVE in the gosu binary of the pinned postgres image (usr/local/bin/gosu only; the same CVE in our own binaries stays blocking). deploy/compose.yaml runs Postgres as `user: postgres`, so the image entrypoint never runs gosu; our backup image removes its own copy. Remove this entry when the pinned postgres image ships a rebuilt gosu. Owner decision 2026-11-07.
